stories.title: AUSL All-Star Cup — Series 3 Day 2 Results (Aug 25)
stories.angle: Monday's Series 3 opener saw Kowalik dominate and Ricketts lose. Tuesday (Aug 25) flips the script slightly: Kowalik held on for another win in a tight game, and Ricketts bounced back with her own win. The individual title race tightens slightly for Ricketts while Kowalik's overall lead remains. 5 days until Series 4 on August 30 crowns the champion.

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text: Series 3, Day 2. Kowalik holds on for another win. Ricketts bounces back with a win of her own. The individual race still has life — but Kowalik leads and keeps winning. Five days until the champion is crowned on Aug 30. #AUSL 🥎

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text: Two days into Series 3 and Kowalik has won both games. Ricketts is fighting back, but closing 260+ pts in one series is a steep ask. The August 30 finale decides it all. Who's watching? #AUSL #WomensSoftball 🥎

stories.title: USA WNT — 18 Days, The Netherlands and Mexico Threat
stories.angle: Eighteen days until USA Softball opens Group Oklahoma at Devon Park. Today's angle: USA is No. 2 in the world, but only the top 2 of 6 nations advance to the 2027 Finals. The Netherlands (No. 6) and Mexico (No. 7) are more than fillers — they're teams capable of producing an upset or a close result that pushes USA's margin to the limit. Preview of the two most dangerous opponents.

stories.title: Oklahoma Softball — Battle Series and Transfer Integration
stories.angle: Oklahoma's Battle Series format isn't just competition for starting spots — it's a team-building exercise for a roster that added significant transfer talent alongside existing players. Berzon (from LSU), Harter (from MTSU), and others are learning OU's culture in a competition-first environment. How Gasso uses the intrasquad format to evaluate and integrate diverse roster pieces heading into 2027.

x_posts.label: Post 4
x_posts.text: OU's fall camp is where the rebuild really starts. Berzon (2x AA from LSU) and Harter (.346 BA from MTSU) are learning Gasso's system in a competitive environment from day one. 4 Sooners are away for WNT through Sept 16. #OUSoftball 🥎

stories.title: Teagan Kavan — 500 Career Strikeouts and What's Next
stories.angle: Kavan recorded her 500th career strikeout in April 2026 vs. Oklahoma. Her 2026 season: 2.33 ERA, career-high 260 strikeouts, 228.2 innings. Returning as a senior with Isa Torres alongside her and a three-peat bid underway, fall camp is where the next chapter begins.

x_posts.label: Post 5
x_posts.text: Teagan Kavan hit 500 career strikeouts in April vs. Oklahoma. She finished 2026 with 260 K and a 2.33 ERA. Now she's back in fall camp at Texas chasing a three-peat. Isa Torres (.530 BA, D1Softball POY) is beside her. #HookEm 🤘
